newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks ease on baht weakness by lunch.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks ease on baht weakness by lunch.

text.p: The Thai baht's sustained losses and absence of positive news prompted more foreign selling with the finance sector leading the morning decline, brokers said on Thursday.
"Foreigners took profits on finance issues bought earlier this month. The liquidation was induced by worries about the baht weakness," a broker said.
The baht fell to a new record low of 32.70 to the dollar onshore early on Thursday. The composite SET index lost 0.76 point to 630.52 on 2.6 billion baht turnover by the lunch break.
"Some foreigners stayed on the sidelines this morning, probably waiting to enter the market when the baht slips further," the broker said.
Most major sectors retreated. The finance counter lost 4.99 percent but banks gained 0.92 percent.
Dhana Siam Finance topped the active list, falling 3.75 baht to 34.75, Bangkok Bank gained two to 168.
